what: Cloud-signature separability. Pre-registration: cloud_prereg.json at 927c4e2, no result attached. FIRST RESULT AT 85a50c7 WAS CIRCULAR AND IS CORRECTED HERE — read the corrected headline, not that one.

THE_CORRECTION.what_went_wrong: The positive control was the OUTPUT of the quantity the signature uses. `recipe.json` `stack.why` — ONE KEY OVER from the `stack.exclude` list I read — states the criterion: 'auto-cull, standing policy: defect-side robust z >= 3.5 flags exclude', with per-frame flags. Parsed: 44 of 44 flagged on `nstars`, 29 of 44 also on `bg`. So the block IS the output of a z-threshold on the two fields the test measured.
THE_CORRECTION.my_error_named: I reported the criterion as UNDOCUMENTED. It was documented in the adjacent key of the same object. My own rule — the field is the datum, the prose beside it is not — failed on me by one field.
THE_CORRECTION.what_it_invalidates: the full-44 numbers, and the claim that both pre-registered bars were met. The positive bar was met BY A CIRCULAR MEASUREMENT: on that control the signature could not have failed.
THE_CORRECTION.the_general_lesson: A POSITIVE CONTROL DRAWN FROM A RECORDS FIELD IS ONLY A CONTROL FOR SIGNATURES THAT DO NOT USE THAT FIELD. Check the cull provenance before using a cull as a control.

CORRECTED_HEADLINE: bg separates the block at Z +4.05 on n=15 frames selected WITHOUT reference to bg, against +1.12 in a matched clean set — a 3.6x margin. Real, non-circular, and weaker than the withdrawn +6.07. Z_nstars carries NO information here and is withdrawn entirely.

bg_on_nstars_only_frames.why_non_circular: these 15 were flagged on `nstars` ONLY; `bg` was not their selection criterion.
bg_on_nstars_only_frames.AND_THE_BIAS_RUNS_AGAINST_THE_FINDING: being nstars-only means their bg robust-z was BELOW the 3.5 cull threshold — they are conditioned AGAINST high bg. Removing the bg-flagged frames can only lower the subset's bg median. So +4.05 is CONSERVATIVE, not merely non-circular.

fwhm_any_population.why_non_circular: `fwhm` was NOT a cull field for any of the 44 frames.
fwhm_any_population.what_it_supports: star SHAPE did not move while star COUNT fell. The frames did not get softer, so the loss is transparency rather than seeing or focus. This survives the circularity.

negative_control_is_MATCHED_not_merely_u.the_identical_detector_ran_and_found_not: its cull_report.txt reads 'no frame flags at defect-side z >= 3.5' over all 502 frames
negative_control_is_MATCHED_not_merely_u.why_this_matters: the baseline is not 'a set nobody culled' but 'a set the same z-flagger examined and passed'.

CIRCULAR_KEPT_FOR_THE_RECORD_DO_NOT_QUOT.why_circular: every frame in all three populations was selected by a threshold on nstars; 29 were also selected on bg.

WHAT_DIES.PM_claim_b_REFUTED_as_unsupported: 'nstars carries the signature more strongly than bg' was an artifact of selection — all 44 frames were nstars-flagged, so Z_nstars measures the cull, not the sky.
WHAT_DIES.do_NOT_land_the_intake_culling_correctio: the item's note that star COUNT is 'measured blind on rich fields (detection saturates at the cap)' is NOT contradicted by this data. The earlier report said it was; that is withdrawn.

A_FURTHER_LIMIT_NOBODY_HAS_CLOSED.the_block_is_an_auto_cull_output_not_an_: nothing in the tree establishes by observation that these frames contain cloud. `prompts/REPORT.md:470` names it a 'cloud block' and `recipe.json` records it as an auto-cull on z-flags. So the control is 'what the z-flagger flagged', and 'cloud' is an interpretation layered on that.
A_FURTHER_LIMIT_NOBODY_HAS_CLOSED.consequence: a signature validated against this control is validated against the existing auto-cull, not against cloud.

WHAT_WOULD_CLOSE_IT: a cloud block identified by something independent of the frame-QA fields — an observing log, an all-sky camera, or a human note recorded at capture time — on a second night.
instrument: Siril bg / nstars / fwhm via the frame-QA stage. In-house part: the block statistic. REPORTS ONLY — no cull built, nothing gated, no deliverable touched.
statistic: Z = (median in-block - median out-of-block) / (1.4826 * MAD out-of-block)
